description: Guidances, designations, advisory committees, decisions, consultations and policy changes from FDA, EMA, MHRA and other agencies on your topics, with sources. One table of regulatory items, an events feed with a calendar of deadlines, and a monthly scan + digest and high-impact alert run by Claude or ChatGPT.
whenToUse: Follow regulators on your topics: new and draft guidances, designations, advisory committees, decisions, policy changes and open consultations with their deadlines, and which programs they affect, with a monthly digest.
whenNotToUse: Preparing your own submissions (Trial Regulatory Submission), tracking authority questions on your filings, approvals and HTA for marketed products (Market Radar), regulatory or legal advice.
